presets.label: Surrounding terrain
presets.description: Real surrounding roads, water and green space. A violet border with a pale halo marks Leipzig; geography fades into muted ground at the wrap and poles.

presets.label: Continent Leipzig
presets.description: Leipzig becomes an island continent, with soft shallows and a pale shoreline that opens at lakes and rivers.

presets.label: Fog of war
presets.description: Unexplored country disappears into soft sage-grey mist, fading from the map's warm paper tones.
